about: Finish of the shared roadmap model, keyed by part id (GLB node ids of model/base_glb.js and upper-body part ids of model/model.js). colours: RAL reference and a standard sRGB approximation; a physical RAL sample governs. parts: the colour of a part. classes: physically based values of each material class (roughness, metalness and, where named, a small procedural texture generated in model.js at load; nothing is downloaded). class_of: the material class of a part, or of single primitives of a GLB node ('*' for the whole node, a primitive index for one primitive). A class sets roughness and metalness; the colour stays the one of parts, else the colour of the GLB or of model.js, unless the class names a colour. Parts in no class keep their previous values; parts in parts but in no class keep the roughness and metalness of their finish. Visual material classes for rendering, not a manufacturing or material specification. Visualization only.
finishes_note: matte and satin name the finish of a colour; roughness and metalness of a classed part come from its class.
unchanged_note: Parts whose colour is not set here (colour of the GLB or of model.js). The hub motor wheels and the castor wheels take the colour of the rubber class.

powder_coated_steel.about: Powder-coated steel sheet: dielectric coat, subtle orange-peel relief. specular 0.3 (three.js specularIntensity) damps the grazing-angle reflection of the textured coat, so the RAL 7016 cover shows a soft sheen, not a mirror; roughness 0.62 with no roughness map.

anodised_aluminium.about: Anodised aluminium: metallic, brushed roughness variation along the length of the part.

satin_aluminium.about: Satin aluminium of the lift column and the head camera bracket (colours of model.js): roughness 0.4, metalness 0.8, environment at env_scale 0.38 of the page value for metals, so the key light and the environment model its faces (lit face about its own colour, faces turned away about 20 % darker) instead of reflecting the room flat white.

printed_petg.about: Printed PETG: dielectric, faint layer lines (0.3 mm pitch).

rubber.about: Rubber tyre or castor wheel tread.

sensor_glass.about: Sensor window or lens: dark, glossy coat, no transmission.

pcb.about: Printed circuit board, green solder mask (colour of the GLB).

openarm_as_delivered.about: OpenArm 2.0 meshes: as-delivered vertex colours; the upstream description gives no per-part roughness or metalness, so the values are unchanged.

battery_provisional.about: Battery cell-group envelope: keeps its translucent provisional look (cells and shell alpha of the GLB).

class_notes.base_plate: steel deck (component list: steel deck); colour of the GLB
class_notes.lift_column, head_camera_bracket: aluminium primitives of option B, satin; colours of model.js (also the lift stage and the tote rails of the robot page, which share these materials)
class_notes.castor_*: primitive 1 is the wheel; primitive 0 (fork and plate) unchanged
class_notes.lidar: primitive 2 is the window band of the LiDAR envelope
class_notes.base_camera: primitive 1 is the front glass, primitive 2 the lenses
class_notes.head_camera: the two lens discs of the ZED Mini primitive (material lens of model.js)
class_notes.compute: primitives 0 and 2 are the carrier and module boards, primitive 3 the heatsink
class_notes.not classed: controller_plate, driver_mount, lidar_spacer, motor_driver, tof_*, ultrasonic_*, slot_cover_strips and the robot page fittings keep their values
